shell.footer: Explore flights, stays and airport transfers, assisted by AI.
shell.poweredBy: Powered by the AI trip assistant

home.title: Plan it once. Fly, stay and ride.
home.description: TripPilot connects to your preferred LLM through the AI trip assistant, so travel planning is just a conversation.
home.servicesSubtitle: Compare travel options and plan your itinerary.
home.assistantSubtitle: Every message is an AI trip assistant run: events stream in, tools execute in the browser, and results return to the model.

flight.title: Find a flight
flight.text: Compare fares across airlines and let the assistant identify suitable connections.

stay.title: Find a place to stay
stay.text: Hotels, apartments and villas in any city, filtered by budget and rating.

taxi.title: Airport transfer
taxi.text: A transfer matched to your arrival or departure time. Coming soon.

describe.title: Describe the trip
describe.text: Use plain language, for example: "Vienna, first weekend of June, two people".

stream.title: AI trip assistant streams it
stream.text: The agent streams events, state and tool calls straight into the interface.

confirm.title: You decide
confirm.text: TripPilot only helps you explore options; no reservation is made here.

flights.title: Flights
flights.description: Compare available fares or ask the assistant to research options for you.
flights.empty: No flights matched that search. Try different dates.

stays.title: Stays
stays.description: Hotels, apartments and villas, filtered by budget and guest rating.
stays.empty: Nothing matched that budget. Try raising the nightly cap or changing dates.
stays.selected: {name} added to your trip plan — {price} total.

taxi.title: Airport transfer
taxi.description: Airport transfer planning is coming soon. You can leave a demo request to preview the experience.
taxi.estimate: Demo estimate: {price}. No transfer has been reserved.

roadmap.landing: Pick-up time synchronized with your planned landing time.
roadmap.fare: An upfront indicative fare before you continue to a supplier.
roadmap.vehicle: Vehicle options matched to your party and luggage.

assistant.title: Trip assistant
assistant.empty: Ask about your trip. The assistant can help search flights, stays and planned airport transfers.
